term.label: sequence_variant_causing_complex_change_of_translational_product

definition.text: Any sequence variant effect that is known at nucleotide level but cannot be explained by using other key terms.

comments: OBSOLETE: This term was deleted as it conflated more than one term. The alteration is separate from the effect.
